name: labs/schimmilab__pico-mcp
title: PicoScope 5000A/B series oscilloscope (pico_mcp.scope.Scope)
intro: PicoScope 5000A/B series oscilloscope (pico_mcp.scope.Scope), adapted from schimmilab/pico-mcp. It reads `connected`, `variant`, `serial`, `resolution_bits` and 1 more; sets `channel_a_enabled`, `channel_a_coupling`, `channel_a_range_v`, `channel_b_enabled` and 8 more; runs `set_signal_generator`, `stop_signal_generator` and `capture_block`. `set_signal_generator`: configure the built-in signal generator (AWG) through ps5000aSetSigGenBuiltInV2. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/schimmilab__pico-mcp --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/schimmilab__pico-mcp --backend fake --mcp
